mutations.name: the cap rounds up
kills: word budget rounds a fractional cap down: a 5 s code slot holds 11 words, not 12

mutations.name: one word over the cap passes
kills: word budget passes a beat at exactly its cap and fails one word over

mutations.name: every beat type gets the story rate
kills: word budget caps each beat type at its own band rate: 25 words in 10 s fit a concept beat but not a code beat

mutations.name: a block takes its slowest beat type's rate
kills: word budget caps a profile block at its longest airtime, at the fastest rate its beat types allow
